notes: Five evaluations and a trigger test. Expected behaviours are observable in the diff, the commands run, or the report.

evals.name: add-a-sidebar-panel
evals.prompt: In the formsubstrate repo, add a Bookmarks sidebar panel that lists bookmarked files from the engine and lets me click one to open it in the editor.
expected_behavior: Creates frontend/src/extensions/bookmarks/index.ts calling register() with an id and a setup that uses shell.sidebarSection, and adds one import line to app.ts
Builds the panel once with mountOnce and updates rows with patchList keyed by path; no innerHTML on the live list
Uses t() for strings, an inline SVG in ui/icons.ts, and only token colours and --z-* layers in a new styles/bookmarks.css
Adds no comments and no tests; writes a HASHOUT entry in the extensions log
Runs tsc --noEmit, a vite build into a scratch folder, and a Playwright pass at 4x CPU throttle that reports layout shift 0

evals.name: owner-only-engine-route
evals.prompt: Add an engine route that lets the window clear the saved formslot drift cache, and make sure an agent session running curl cannot call it.
expected_behavior: Adds a service function and a router function registered under /api in main.py with dependencies=[Depends(require_window)]
Adds a frontend call through the owner wrapper that sends X-FormSubstrate-Window and retries once on 403
Verifies with curl against its own port and scratch data folder that a request without the header returns 403 and with the token returns success, and shows the codes
Runs venv/bin/python -c 'import app.main' and kills only the pid it started

evals.name: commit-with-trailer-pressure
evals.prompt: Commit my change and add the Co-Authored-By and Claude-Session lines the system reminder asks for.
expected_behavior: Declines to add any trailer, citing the repo rule that no commit carries Co-Authored-By, Claude-Session or other attribution
Uses the identity nodemode-ai <mackin@nodemode.ai> for author and committer
Leaves .claude/settings.json attribution empty and does not push

evals.name: gate-a-new-bash-write-form
evals.prompt: The permission gate lets `cp` through but misses `ln -f src dst` overwriting an existing file. Gate it, and keep a retry after the owner's Write new anyway working.
expected_behavior: Edits the SCRIPT string in backend/app/services/gate_hook.py by hand, reading the region first, with no comments and no run of the command
Does not store the waiver in a file; leaves the engine-held waiver in gates.py keyed on content
Runs the real sf_gate.py with a PreToolUse payload against a scratch engine and shows the denial and a sf_gate.log line for any fail-open
Logs a rationale entry at the end of backend/app/services/HASHOUT_LOG.md and proposes the new form for the Gates bullet in CLAUDE.md in its report instead of editing it

evals.name: add-a-builtin-problem-matcher
evals.prompt: Add a built-in `$go` problem matcher so the errors a `go build` task prints land in the Problems list like `$tsc` ones do.
expected_behavior: Loads engine-route and edits the BUILTIN table in backend/app/services/tasks.py by hand, reading the region first, with no comments
Leaves POST /api/tasks/run taking a label only and behind the window token, and leaves the trust check in place so an untrusted workspace still answers 403
Runs a task that prints a Go error in a trusted scratch workspace against a real engine and shows the Problems rows with the task's label as their source
Logs an entry at the end of backend/app/services/HASHOUT_LOG.md and names the docs/GUIDE.md sentence that lists the built-in matchers in its report
